2.o: Frank uses a young reporter, Zoe Barnes, to spin a story that puts the White House on its heels. Claire makes a cold-blooded move at work.

9.o: Russo hits the road with V.P. Matthews. Frank and Stamper try to whip up support in Congress. Claire looks out for herself.

9.o: Things get personal when Tusk blindsides the Underwoods with a scandal. Freddy and his BBQ joint get caught up in the mix.

11.o: A Special Prosecutor interrogates Frank. Remy Danton tries to keep his options open. Stamper wrestles with his demons.

12.o: Frank finds himself shut out, and Claire makes a difficult sacrifice. Stamper tries to regain control.

13.o: Frank faces annihilation while the nation is in an uproar. Stamper must tie up loose ends. Claire feels the cost of ruthlessness.

2.o: Claire's U.N. bid runs into trouble. Frank fights off mutiny with a bold address to the country.

3.o: The Russian president's state visit becomes a cold war of wills, and some punks heat things up.

7.o: The damage is done and the Underwoods must repair it. But deep wounds don't heal fast, and sometimes not at all.

8.o: A hurricane endangers more than just the entire East Coast and Frank must make a difficult choice.

9.o: The Jordan Valley erupts in chaos as Frank's campaign is picking up steam. Claire gets distrubing intel and counsels him.

10.o: Frank needs to deal with Petrov one on one while Claire tries to preserve the peace-keeping mission. Sacrifices must be made.

11.o: Things turn ugly when Frank, Jackie, and Heather square off during their first debate. Tom joins Claire on the campaign trail.

12.o: Heather Dunbar goes for the jugular, forcing Claire to confront her worst fears. The rift between Frank and Claire widens.

13.o: In the midst of the Iowa caucuses, Frank and Claire must confront hard truths about each other.

3.o: Claire joins Frank as he stumps in South Carolina, but he doesn't trust her. A disastrous scandal blindsides Frank's campaign on primary day.

6.o: Claire clashes with the Secretary of State over her involvement in negotiations with Russia. Dunbar must choose between her campaign and her ethics.

7.o: Frank and Claire adjust to their new reality. The search for Frank's running mate begins. Frank starts a campaign to weaken Conway's strong support.

9.o: At the convention, Frank and his team publicly push for Catherine Durant to be chosen as his running mate, but privately pursue a different agenda.

10.o: As Frank deals with a new threat to his candidacy, Claire has doubts about their plan. Claire faces a difficult decision concerning her mother.

11.o: Frank ups the ante on the war on terror to counter Conway's public show of strength. Tom joins Claire on the campaign trail.

12.o: Frank asks Will to help deal with extremists threatening to murder hostages. Hammerschmidt digs deeper into the allegations against Frank.

8.o: While Frank attends an elite men's weekend gathering to firm up support, Claire deals with a stranded Russian ship and threats from Petrov.

11.o: As the team tries to control fallout from damaging testimony and leaks, everyone is under suspicion and tensions flare between Frank and Claire.

13.o: In the wake of a surprising announcement, everything at the White House is shaken up. A decision must be made about whether to go to war.

2.o: Claire clashes with the Shepherds and Mark Usher, who pressure her to sign the Future Act. Doug makes an unexpected move.

1.o: The entry-level witch, Makoto Kowata, leaves her parents' house as she begins high school. She moves in with her relatives in Aomori in order to begin her training as a witch. On the day of the move-in, her cousin, Chinatsu, overhears Makoto speaking with her cat and thinks she's a weirdo. Her other cousin, Kei, introduces her to his friend from school, Nao Ishiwatari, but...

2.o: A rare visitor comes to the Kuramoto house. He is refer to as the "Harbinger of Spring" among the witches. After completing his job of bringing spring to Aomori, he comes to see Makoto, the new witch in town. Makoto welcomes the harbinger, but Chinatsu... With spring in Aomori, Kei finds bakke on the street. Discovering that Makoto has never had bakke, he takes some home and cooks them for her.

3.o: As part of witch training, Makoto borrows some land from the Kuramoto family to farm vegetables. The land hadn't been maintained and was full of weeds, so with Chinatsu and Kei's help, she cultivates the land. One day, a mysterious lady pays a visit. It turns out to be Makoto's sister, Akane, who is traveling around the world. Akane discovers that Makoto isn't using any spells, so she teaches her a simple spell to practice.

4.t: A Fortune Teller Veiled in Cherry Blossoms
4.o: Makoto, Kei, and Chinatsu meet a fortune teller at the Cherry Blossom Festival. It turns out, she is a witch named Inukai and knows Akane. A dreadful spell was cast on her by Akane, so Makoto feels obliged to undo the spell and invites her over to their house. Will Makoto successfully undo Akane's spell?

5.o: Chito goes for a walk, and Chinatsu tails him. Later that day, Makoto goes for a walk with Chito as her guide.

6.o: Chinatsu grows very fond of Akane and expresses her desires of becoming a witch. What is Akane's response? Later that day, Akane teaches Makoto a spell that turns snacks into something a little bit more.

7.o: Makoto, Kei, Chinatsu, and Nao go herb picking in the mountains. Chinatsu enjoys picking the herbs but not eating them. However, Akane told her that she can't be a good witch if she's picky with food. She makes an effort to eat some herbs, but they are too bitter for her. To help relieve the bitterness, Akane suggests paying a visit to a nearby cafe to grab a slice of cake.

8.o: Makoto, Kei, and Chinatsu are at Café Concrucio. They introduce themselves to the owner and enjoy a nice relaxing time. They also meet a strange set of regular customers.

9.t: The Day After Tomorrow Is Today
9.o: Makoto shows her vegetable farm to Nao and gives away some radishes. Inukai comes over to apologize for the troubles she caused during the Cherry Blossom Festival and reads the fortunes for Makoto, Kei, and Chinatsu.

10.t: Bad With Cooking and Bad With Bees
10.o: There's a cooking class at school, but Nao isn't very confident in her cooking skills. She had a little accident as a child and was traumatized to cook. Later that week, the Kuramotos go out to thin out their apple farm. Makoto may get "lucky" with a bee.

11.o: A whale that flies around the world is flying over the town. Akane, Makoto, and Chinatsu go out on their brooms to watch and ride the whale. Anzu is also there, and they invite her over to have breakfast.

12.t: A Witch's Robe and Different Ways to Spend the Day
12.o: Makoto finds her old robe and realizes she's outgrown it, so she decides to make a new one. She also decides to surprise Chinatsu by making her one, too.

1.o: Abandoned by her father, Nanami finds herself homeless when she meets a man who offers his own home to her. His home turns out to be a shrine where his supernatural household awaits the return of their lord and master after a 20-year absence.

2.o: Nanami discovers that Kurama, a famous pop star, has transferred to her high school, which spurs her to return to school. However, as a weak land god, her life may be at risk if she wanders outside the shrine alone.

3.o: The land under Mikage Shrine's protection includes Isara Swamp and Himemiko, its guardian mistress, comes to pay her respects to the new land god. And Nanami's divine matchmaking powers are put to the test for the first time.

4.o: Nanami saves a pretty white snake at school and for her trouble, she becomes marked as the snake's intended. Tomoe transfers into Nanami's class to protect her, but the snake comes for her anyway.

5.o: Narukami, god of thunder, has always wanted Tomoe as a familiar for herself. Now that the god he serves is Nanami, a human girl, Narukami sees her chance to take away Nanami's godhood and make Tomoe hers.

6.o: Nanami stays home with a cold while Tomoe goes to school disguised as her in order to keep her attendance rate from slipping. Mizuki takes advantage of Tomoe's absence to pay Nanami a visit.

7.t: The God Asks a Boy Out on a Date
7.o: Nanami experiments a little with her divine powers while she struggles to define exactly how she feels about Tomoe. And Kurama, being the yokai who has more experience with humans, offers some words of advice to Tomoe.

8.t: The God Goes to the Beach
8.o: Summer break is here and Nanami goes to the beach with her friends to take her mind off her broken heart. Trouble ensues when Tomoe accompanies her and goes into the ocean against his better judgment.

9.t: The God Goes to the Dragon King's Palace
9.o: In her quest to recover the stolen Dragon King's right eye and return it to him in exchange for Tomoe's freedom, Nanami travels back in time and gets a glimpse of Tomoe's past.

10.t: Tomoe Becomes a Familiar / The God Goes to a Mixer
10.o: Flashing back to the past, some of what Tomoe went through with Mikage is revealed. And returning to the present for the second part, Nanami gets dragged off to a mixer with her friends.

11.o: Mizuki ventures into the city alone to learn the secret to making it in human society like the super popular pop star Kurama. And Nanami drags Tomoe off on a date to the amusement park.

12.o: Nanami decides to hold an autumn festival at the shrine to let the locals know that it's not abandoned or haunted. But as she prepares for the festival, Otohiko comes along to throw a wrench into things.

13.t: I've Started the "Being a God" Thing
13.o: Unable to exorcise the miasma encroaching on the shrine, Nanami believes she is useless and leaves. Finding her gone, Tomoe and Mizuki go searching for her, leaving the shrine and the miasma to Onikiri and Kotetsu.

1.t: I've Started the "Being a God" Thing Again
1.o: As the land god of the Mikage Shrine, Nanami is invited to the annual gathering of the gods in Izumo, but on the one condition that she must pass a test administered by Otohiko.

2.o: Now that Nanami is set to go to Izumo to attend the Divine Assembly, she must decide who goes with her - Tomoe or Mizuki. And she must also face the consequences of attending a divine event as a mortal being.

3.t: The God Falls Into the Netherworld
3.o: Okuninushi, the god hosting the Divine Assembly, asks Nanami to go handle a situation happening on the border between the worlds of the living and the dead.

4.t: The God Races Across the Netherworld
4.o: Izanami imprisons Kirihito and refuses to allow Nanami to return to the surface with him. Nanami must decide how much she believes in her own powers and what she is willing to risk to save him.

5.t: The God Makes Her Second Romantic Confession
5.o: When Tomoe reverted to being a wild fox to save Nanami, he undid his contract as her familiar. And now, he takes this opportunity to reconsider whether he wants to go back to Nanami or not.

6.t: The God Meets a Little Tengu
6.o: On her way home, Nanami runs into Himemiko and they spend some quality girl time together. Later, she meets a little tengu on a mission.

7.t: The God Goes to Mount Kurama
7.o: Kurama returns to Mount Kurama with Nanami and Tomoe to take Botanmaru home and see if he can help his ailing father.

8.o: Kurama's father is sick, but there is no easy way to get in to see him, so the gang must devise a way to get past Jiro's defenses.

9.o: The ruse is simple. Nanami confers her godly powers to Kurama, so he can pretend to be a god, someone Jiro cannot turn away from the gates. While Kurama and Tomoe distract Jiro, Nanami sneaks in to deliver the cure.

10.t: The God Receives a Romantic Confession
10.o: The search for the Sojobo's soul leads to an unexpected place and an unexpected confession.

11.t: The God Goes Back to Being a Child
11.o: Kirihito, aka Akura-oh, has not given up on getting his body back from the Netherworld. But in the meantime, Nanami and her familiars go to see the Year God, to receive a talisman for the new year.

12.t: The God Receives a Marriage Proposal
12.o: Tomoe gets some insight into Nanami's childhood. And they finally get through the torii gates to see the Year God.

After receiving such a huge shock from her boyfriend, Hae Ra wanders around on the streets and ends up in Sharon Tailor.

13.o: Baek Hee brings Sharon along to look for Jeom Bok, thinking that finding him would solve their problem. Sharon finds out that Hae Ra has the ring, so she steals it from Hae Ra’s room. Meanwhile, Hae Ra tells Soo Ho about the secret her dad's been keeping from him.

14.o: Hae Ra leaves Soo Ho's house because of a letter that Chul Min sent to her. Soo Ho tells Sharon to leave the house right away after finding her looking through his stuff inside his room. Meanwhile, Baek Hee meets the descendent of Jeom Bok at an art gallery.

15.o: Sharon hears from Aunt Sook Hee that Soo Ho proposed to Hae Ra. Baek Hee tells Sharon to make a wedding dress for Hae Ra, but Sharon refuses. Meanwhile, a public hearing for Geumseong-dong's redevelopment is held, and Soo Ho faces a huge uproar from the residents who want to redevelop the town.

16.o: Baek Hee tells the story of Lady Seo Rin, Myung So, and Boon Yi to Jang Bin and manages to borrow the document that she believes was written by Jeom Bok. Meanwhile, Soo Ho keeps having weird flashbacks and asks Sharon if she has anything to do with it.

17.o: Soo Ho is sent to a hospital after getting stabbed by Sharon. Surprisingly, he wakes up without much trouble. Baek Hee tells Sharon to leave the country, so Sharon packs up, but Soo Ho stops Sharon from running away.

18.o: Sharon comes back, but she lost her memories of Hae Ra and Soo Ho. She also lost her ingenuity as a tailor, which makes her frustrated. Meanwhile, Soo Ho and Hae Ra have an argument regarding Hae Ra's transfer to the office in Rome.

19.o: Soo Ho wakes up without a scratch on his body after the accident. When Baek Hee finds this out, she gets concerned that Soo Ho might have become immortal. After Sharon realizes that she's finally aging, she meets Hae Ra and tells her that Soo Ho has become a monster.

20.o: Baek Hee has a hard time recovering from Sharon's attack. Hae Ra and Soo Ho get ready to say goodbye to Baek Hee. Gon wants to save his father from becoming more evil, so he asks Young Mi to confess everything to the police. Meanwhile, Hae Ra tries to figure out a way to turn Soo Ho back to normal, but there seems to be no easy way out.

1.t: The Reason to Live, the Reason to Save Someone
1.o: After getting alarming news from his fiancee, Cha Min has a mishap and receives an object called Abyss. Go Se-yeon meets someone who says that he is a friend.

2.t: Neither the Living nor the Dead
2.o: Min explains what he did to Se-yeon, who is in disbelief over her circumstances. Vowing to find her killer, she comes up with a way to help Min and herself.

3.t: The Truth Hidden by the Facts
3.o: Se-yeon and Min are stunned by what Park Gi-man has been doing, and they unwittingly get help from a police detective who thinks that she is someone else.

4.o: Convinced that he has seen his ex-fiancee, Min is frantic to talk to her, but Se-yeon tries to remind him that he is not the same person anymore.

5.o: After making a horrific discovery, Se-yeon considers using Abyss and tries to persuade Park Dong-cheol to keep investigating the murder of the prosecutor.

6.o: Park Dong-cheol tries to hunt down Oh Yeong-cheol, who keeps eluding the police. Min's mother doesn't know what to make of the changes she sees in her son.

7.o: Se-yeon finds herself viewing Min in a different light after realizing he has always been by her side. Jang Hui-jin reveals something surprising to Min.

8.o: Park Dong-cheol demands to know why Se-yeon interferes with the case. Someone claiming to be Lee Mi-do appears out of nowhere.

9.o: Se-yeon tries to explain her actions to Min and has an emotional reunion with her mother. Hui-jin refuses to back down upon being confronted by Min's mother.

10.o: Se-yeon gets a feeling that she may be in danger, Min reveals a secret about his father, and Hui-jin's mother becomes agitated after seeing someone on the television.

11.o: After Park Dong-cheol alerts him about Oh Yeong-cheol, Min goes looking for Se-yeon. Lee Mi-do's parents get a perplexing proposal from Min's mother.

12.o: Se-yeon senses something unnerving about Seo Ji-uk; Hui-jin gets an unexpected visitor and has an idea about what Oh Yeong-cheol could be planning to do.

13.o: While attempting to help Park Gi-man with a case, Se-yeon and Min discover something strange. Seo Ji-uk gets a visitor.

14.o: Seo Ji-uk puts his plan in motion. On the way to meet Se-yeon, Min receives a disturbing call from Park Dong-cheol and struggles with a difficult decision.

15.o: Min and Se-yeon set out to acquire evidence against Seo Ji-uk, with Park Dong-cheol's help. Min's mother questions Se-yeon about her intentions.

16.o: After proposing to Min, Se-yeon copes with the consequences of his sacrifice and reveals the truth to her parents. Seo Ji-uk's trial begins.

1.o: The first episode examines the start of the Unabomber's campaign of terror spanning from 1978 to 1985, and dives into Kaczynski’s childhood to discover what might have made a young mathematical genius with few friends evolve into a sociopathic terrorist.

2.o: Picking up in 1985, Part Two tells the story of how the Unabomber began to ramp-up his terror campaign, claiming his first murder and taunting his FBI pursuers. Kaczynski’s secret journals from his time as a grad student in Michigan reveal the extraordinary moment when his thoughts first turned to murder.

3.o: Part Three recounts the period from 1993 to 1996, when the Unabomber was holding America ransom with a series of increasingly powerful bombs before his arrest in 1996. Kaczynski's brother and sister-in-law reveal the emotional story of how they came to suspect he was the Unabomber, which ultimately led to his arrest.

4.o: The final episode of the series examines Kaczynski's trial, with the revelation that he was subjected to a secret psychological experiment as a teenaged student at Harvard, a fact some claim could have been responsible for turning him into the terrorist he became.

1.o: Hours before leaving the country, Kang Si-yeong steps in as a correctional physician and saves a life with the helping hand of Cha Yo-han.

Meanwhile, US Treasury investigator Edward Homm may finally be ready to cooperate and help find Crowley. Liv, Weir's ex-wife, is dragged back into his world of secrets, and we see a new side of The Intern, the only member of Weir's original team spared in the explosion.

5.o: Homm begins to unravel how Intaverse ties in with Crowley's master plan as Crowley's forces start to close in. Hailey tries in vain to get Weir, who is continually distracted by the puzzle of Valence’s death, to trust her. Meanwhile, Agent Madi investigates Weir's ex-wife, Liv, for possible clues. And, Ben has a secret…

Meanwhile, a distraught Intern enlists Eliza for help.

7.o: Weir and his team are in desperate straits. With the Shared Data Act about to pass, Weir's paranoia about Ben and anxiety over Crowley begin to get the better of him as he tries not to disappear down a rabbit hole of possibilities. Hailey watches with mounting concern while Homm's celebrity grows on Morgan Shaw's podcast. Agent Madi receives a mysterious note, and Liv gets a delivery.

8.o: Weir is forced to play his final ace when Crowley's nefarious psyop to win support of the Shared Data Act and hijack democracy succeeds. But Crowley's counter puts both Liv and Ben in mortal danger.

Meanwhile, Ja-yeon, worried about Gyu-hyun, visits the orphanage and almost runs into Ha-jun.

9.o: Hae-yeong and Ji-uk reconcile. Ji-uk's place turns into chaos when Gyu-hyun visits him upon learning of his secret. Hae-yeong is bound to face losses in the fight between Gyu-hyun and his father. Will she fight back or back down?

What will become of their complicated relationship?

10.o: يعقد المحاميان الناجحان "برينغس" و"بينش" النية على التقاعد… ولكن ليس قبل أن يدافعا عن الشركة المصنّعة لمرحاض متقدم تقنيًّا في مرافعة ضد "لينكون" وفريقه.

1.o: When Natsumi's body is found over two years after her disappearance, her husband Riku embarks on a dangerous search for her killer.

2.o: Hoping to avoid a confrontation with businessman Goroku, Riku faces a brutal dilemma: catch a thief who stole 1 billion yen or face lethal consequences.

3.o: Riku and Ichika uncover a new suspect in the 1-billion-yen case and meet Gido's wife, whose presence quickly draws the attention of other detectives.

4.o: Another theft hits Goroku, but there may be video of the culprit. At Mayu's insistence, Riku travels to the mountains to try and learn the truth.

5.o: Riku and Ichika find a new motivation to crack the case after they team up to tail the real Gido, who accidentally leads them to a criminal cabal.

6.o: After the police make an arrest in the case, Gido contacts Riku, desperate for his help in exposing the real culprits behind the 1 billion-yen theft.

7.o: Now that it's too late for Riku to return to his old life, he investigates the murder of one of Goroku's clients with a personal connection to Fuyuhashi.

8.o: Desperate and erratic, Riku enlists Fuyuhashi's help in manipulating a hospitalized Ayaka to develop a lead on the still-missing Ichika.

9.o: Riku attempts a daring rescue and sets his sights on destroying Goroku's criminal empire, even if it puts his life in grave danger.

10.o: As Goroku's final plan unfolds with 10 billion yen en route, Riku uncovers the truth behind Natsumi's disappearance two years ago.

1.o: حين يقبع "ديفيد بوروز" خلف القضبان متهمًا بجريمة قتل لم يرتكبها، يعقد العزم على الهرب بعدما يكتشف أمرًا صادمًا... أنّ ابنه قد يكون حيًّا يُرزق.

2.o: يدخل مكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي إلى الصورة بينما يحاول "ديفيد" التخفي عن الأنظار. ويواجه رجلا عائلة "ماكنزي" ضغوطًا شديدة مع تزايد التساؤلات والشكوك حول دورهما في هذه القضية.

3.o: يخاطر "ديفيد" و"رايتشل" بحرّيتهما للعثور على "هيلدي وينسلو"، ويكشف "ليني" و"فيليب" الستار عن حقيقة صادمة عن ليلة وفاة "ماثيو".

4.o: يتعين على "هايدن" اتخاذ قرار بشأن استعداده لمساعدة الضيف غير المتوقع الذي يختبئ في منزله، بينما تصل "رايتشل" إلى طريق مسدود، ويقدّم "ليني" إلى "شيريل" دليلًا محوريًا جديدًا.

5.o: يلجأ "ديفيد" إلى اتخاذ إجراءات يائسة لاستدراج عدو له، وتحاول "رايتشل" احتواء الموقف بعد تعرضها لخيانة كبرى. أمّا "هايدن"، فيضطر إلى اختيار الجانب الذي يؤيده.

6.o: يجد "ديفيد" نفسه مضطرًّا إلى اتخاذ قرار مصيري مؤلم، وتواجه "رايتشل" خطرًا جسيمًا، بينما يأتي سعي "سارة" و"ماكس" وراء الحقيقة بثمن باهظ.

7.o: يكمن داخل المستشفى دليل مهم قد يقود إلى العثور على "ماثيو"، شرط أن يتمكن "ديفيد" و"رايتشل" من إقناع "رونالد" بمساعدتهما. أمّا "سارة"، فتكسب حليفًا جديدًا في مسار تحقيقها.

8.o: بمساعدة حليفة غير متوقعة، لا يملك "ديفيد" و"رايتشل" سوى فرصة واحدة لإنقاذ "ماثيو" من أيدي خاطفَيه قبل أن يضيع منهما إلى الأبد.
